name: Comic Market 109 (Winter Comiket)
notes: Official C109 dates 29-31 Dec 2026 (Tue-Thu), first three-day Comiket since C97; East halls 4-6 stay closed for renovation. Circle setup is 28 Dec. C109 wristband prices were not published as of 10 Oct 2026 (committee said late Oct or early Nov). badgePriceUsd 8 is an estimate from the C108 AM-entry wristband at JPY 1,210 (~JPY 156 per USD on 10 Oct 2026); PM entry that year was JPY 440 in advance or JPY 1,000 on site. contestPrizeUsd is 0 because Comiket has no official cash cosplay prize; cosplay is limited to designated areas, some of them outdoor (rooftop, garden), while halls are indoor. hotelPerNightUsd 200 is an estimate for a mid Ariake or Toyosu room on Comiket nights, above the roughly USD 70-110 off-peak business rate. Comic Market 110 (summer 2027) has no published dates; the committee expects a return to two days once all 16 halls reopen in 2027, with circle applications planned around Feb 2027.

name: Tokyo Game Show 2027
notes: CESA announced TGS 2027 for 16-20 Sep 2027 (Thu-Mon holiday), five days at Makuhari Messe, matching the length planned for 2026 (whose 21 Sep public day was canceled for a typhoon; 257,642 attended over four days). Business versus public split for 2027 is not posted yet. badgePriceUsd 19 estimates the TGS 2026 public one-day ticket of JPY 3,000 at ~JPY 156/USD; 2027 prices are unpublished. Cosplay in 2026 needed a separate registration fee (JPY 2,000) plus a day ticket. contestPrizeUsd is 0: no cash cosplay purse was found; the Japan Game Awards on site are for games, not costumes. hotelPerNightUsd 140 is an estimate for a Makuhari business hotel during the show. Indoor halls.

name: AnimeJapan 2027
notes: First AnimeJapan outside Tokyo, and 2028 is also slated for Osaka. Official outline: business day 26 Mar 2027 (Hall 1, 10:00-18:00) plus 27 Mar (10:00-17:00); public days 27-28 Mar 2027, halls 2-6, 09:00-17:00, last entry 16:30. Address 1-5-102 Nanko-kita, Suminoe-ku. badgePriceUsd 16 estimates the recent advance adult one-day of JPY 2,500 (~JPY 156/USD); the 2027 public price is not on the outline page. Cosplay has historically required an extra cosplay ticket. contestPrizeUsd is 0 for costume: no cash cosplay prize was found. A separate AnimeJapan New Creator Award 2027 offers a JPY 1,000,000 grand prix (~USD 6,410) for student short animation, not cosplay. hotelPerNightUsd 110 is an estimate for a 3-star near Nanko or Cosmosquare. Indoor.

name: Wonder Festival 2027 Winter
notes: Official announcement on 8 Feb 2026: Wonder Festival 2027 Winter runs 13-14 Feb 2027 (Sat-Sun) at Makuhari Messe international halls 1-8, the first two-day WonFes in 36 years. Organizers are the Wonder Festival executive committee and Kaiyodo. 2027 ticket prices were not posted (visitor info was deferred until after Wonder Festival 2026 Summer). badgePriceUsd 22 estimates the 2026 Winter advance ticket of JPY 3,500 (U22 JPY 2,200, afternoon JPY 2,300, same-day JPY 4,000) at ~JPY 156/USD. This is a figure and garage-kit fair. contestPrizeUsd is 0: awards are for models and sculpture, not a published cash cosplay purse. hotelPerNightUsd 95 is an estimate for a February Makuhari 3-star, below TGS-week rates. Indoor.

name: Supanova Comic Con & Gaming Sydney
notes: Official Supanova homepage and 2027 exhibitor kit: Sydney 18-20 Jun 2027 at Sydney Showground, Olympic Park, about 44,000 expected, including a Level Up Friday. Chosen over SMASH! because SMASH! 2027 dates are not announced (2026 was 11-12 Jul at ICC Sydney, attendance 53,071). 2027 ticket prices are TBA. badgePriceUsd 35 estimates the 2026 Sydney Saturday day pass of A$49.50 at ~0.70 USD per AUD (2026 weekend pass was A$77.50, about USD 54; Friday day was A$30). The Sunday cosplay contest has craftsmanship, performance, and best-in-show style awards, but no cash purse was published for 2026 or 2027, so contestPrizeUsd is 0. hotelPerNightUsd 180 is an estimate for a Sydney Olympic Park hotel in June. Indoor halls. Categories stay inside the allowed set; the show also covers film and TV.

name: Anime Festival Asia Singapore 2026
notes: Official site: 27-29 Nov 2026 at Suntec Singapore halls 401-406, with three nights of concerts (including Yuki Kajiura on 27 Nov) and a cosplay program. Marks 60 years of Singapore-Japan diplomatic relations. 2026 ticket prices were still unannounced as of 10 Oct 2026. badgePriceUsd 17 estimates the 2025 early-bird one-day exhibition ticket from SGD 22 at ~0.78 USD/SGD (2025 early-bird 3-day exhibition was SGD 62). contestPrizeUsd is 0 because the 2026 purse is not posted. AFASG25 singles was SGD 1,200 / 600 / 300, about USD 937 / 469 / 234 at the same FX, and that is last year's figure, not a 2026 confirmation. hotelPerNightUsd 210 is an estimate for a 3-star near Suntec or Marina Bay in late November. Indoor.

name: Comic Fiesta 2026
notes: Next edition is 19-20 Dec 2026 at KLCC (Wikipedia, updated Oct 2026, and Malaysian event calendars). Comic Fiesta 2025 drew about 75,000. 2026 ticket sales were not open as of early Oct 2026. badgePriceUsd 13 estimates the 2025 one-day pass of RM55 at ~0.245 USD/MYR; the 2025 weekend pass was RM99 (~USD 24) and the afternoon pass RM35. contestPrizeUsd is 0 because a 2026 main-hall cosplay cash purse was not published. Related 2025 figures, not this edition: a mall runway with Comic Fiesta advertised a RM4,100 pool, and the Comic Fiesta x pixiv illustration grand prize was RM3,000. hotelPerNightUsd 130 is an estimate for a KLCC-area 3-star in mid-December. Indoor.

name: Petit Fancy 45 x Reality Fantasy 14
venue: Taipei Expo Park Expo Dome (Huabo Zhengyan Hall)
notes: Organizer Fancy Frontier lists PF45 x RF14 for 7-8 Nov 2026 at Taipei Expo Park Expo Dome (花博公園爭艷館), No. 1 Yumen Street, Zhongshan District. Public hours are typically 10:30-17:00 Saturday and 10:30-16:30 Sunday. The next large Fancy Frontier after FF47 (21-23 Aug 2026, same hall) is not dated in this window; FFK19 Kaohsiung is 5-6 Dec 2026 and is a different event. Admission has long been catalogue-based at about TWD 200; badgePriceUsd 6 is that estimate at ~0.031 USD/TWD, and the 2026 public price was not fully posted. contestPrizeUsd is 0: this is a doujin and model fair with cosplay allowed, and no cash cosplay grand prize was published. hotelPerNightUsd 120 is an estimate for a 3-star near Yuanshan. Indoor hall. Comic World WINTER 2026 (12-13 Dec, KINTEX, Goyang) was left out to keep this file at eight events.
